whenToUse: A press kit, brand assets, templates or datasets a visitor downloads one by one or all at once.
Files generated in the browser (texts, SVGs from tokens) that should be bundled into one ZIP.
avoidWhen: Files attached to a record in an admin panel — use attachment-list.
Very large or private files — create the archive on the server.
a11y: Tri-state select all; every row checkbox and download button is named after its file.
Progress and results (saved, failed, files left out) are announced through a polite status line.
